reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: A non-streamed project chat with no tools, goal or hooks kept no durable turn, so #1187's lane release never ran and it held the project's work lane for the whole provider call. When a durable runner holds the lane, the chat route now requests a durable turn so the lane is released before provider admission. Selected: the new lane-turn regression, durable delivery (#1187 release), chat acceptance, chat leftovers and Butler resource paths that assert the in-process turnless behaviour; SQLite and PostgreSQL.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright layer: the caller receives the same response. The project-level effect was measured on a fake scratch Core with a trickling provider stub.
